# libs/spartan-ui: stock spartan/ui helm components

The **unmodified** spartan/ui helm components, generated by the spartan CLI (style `vega`, see `/components.json`). The Storybooks and the apps use them through the `@spartan-ng/helm/*` path aliases in the root `tsconfig.json`.

They are consumer-owned code, the way spartan/ui intends: workspace-local, not a package. Packages reach them only through spartan's own `@spartan-ng/helm/*` alias, never by path, so a package split into its own repository just generates its own copy with the same command.

**Do not edit them by hand.** Spartan Native restyles them from CSS only (`@spartan-native/theme/styles`), through the `data-slot` hooks listed in `packages/theme/src/styles/_hooks.scss`. Keeping them stock proves the theme works on what real apps have.

## Add or update a component

```bash
npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui <name>     # e.g. dialog, dropdown-menu, tooltip
```

Currently generated: every component the spartan CLI offers (66): accordion, alert, alert-dialog, aspect-ratio, attachment, autocomplete, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, bubble, button, button-group, calendar, card, carousel, chart, checkbox, code-block, collapsible, combobox, command, context-menu, date-picker, dialog, drawer, dropdown-menu, empty, field, hover-card, input, input-group, input-otp, item, kbd, label, marker, menubar, message, message-scroller, native-select, navigation-menu, pagination, popover, progress, questionnaire, radio-group, resizable, scroll-area, select, separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, slider, sonner, spinner, switch, table, tabs, textarea, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip, trace, typography, utils.

After adding one, add its hooks to `_hooks.scss` and a skin partial per platform (see the theme README, "Adding a component skin").
